name: Neighbourhood Ecosystem Fund

funder.name: Carman Family Foundation and the Scottish Government's Nature Restoration Fund

summary: Development-stage grants for small, community-led groups in Scotland to design and plan local ecosystem restoration projects, with extra fundraising support for successful groups.

status.quote: You can apply to the Neighbourhood Ecosystem Fund at any time through our simple two-stage application process.

applicant_types.quote: To apply for this funding, you must be a not-for-profit community-led organisation based in a specific place in Scotland.

geography.quote: To apply for this funding, you must be a not-for-profit community-led organisation based in a specific place in Scotland.

access.quote: You can apply for this rolling programme at any time by submitting a short Expression of Interest Form.

window.quote: This fund is open on a rolling basis.

amount.quote: You can apply for up to £13,500 to pay for the activities of your project.

administered_by.quote: The Neighbourhood Ecosystem Fund is a multi-investor programme supported by the Carman Family Foundation, the Scottish Government's Nature Restoration Fund (managed by NatureScot), and other partners, and is managed by Inspiring Scotland.
